screens.title: The Map
screens.caption: Every section of the tracker as a card with its count and status. Pick one to open it.

hotspots.title: Doom box
hotspots.text: Up to three sections you've chosen to keep an eye on, with their count and status. Click one to open it. Pick them in Settings.

hotspots.title: Categories
hotspots.text: Show only Home, Self, Lab or Work projects, or the untagged ones. Counts update as you tag.

hotspots.title: Display
hotspots.text: Switch the layout (Grid, Map or Classic) and pick a look, its intensity and motion.

hotspots.title: Notes
hotspots.text: Your own notes on any panel, kept in this browser.

hotspots.title: Minimize map
hotspots.text: Hides the section cards so the look's moving background shows through. Click again to bring them back.

hotspots.title: Search + toolbar
hotspots.text: Search box, filters and sort for the project list.

hotspots.title: Tracker tools
hotspots.text: Sweep for new folders, add a folder, export or import CSV, and git sync.

hotspots.title: Filter pills
hotspots.text: Quick filters with counts; amber and red ones flag problems.

hotspots.title: Project list + detail
hotspots.text: One row per project, grouped by area. Click a row to open its detail panel.

hotspots.title: Tree or flat
hotspots.text: Show projects inside other projects nested under them, or as one flat list.

hotspots.title: Status tabs
hotspots.text: Open, active, waiting, unreviewed, paused and done, with how many are in each.

hotspots.title: Search
hotspots.text: Finds projects by name, note, next step, path or to-do.

hotspots.title: Sweep
hotspots.text: Looks through your project folders for new ones and adds them as unreviewed.

hotspots.title: Git sync
hotspots.text: Checks every repo against GitHub: public, private, a fork, or deleted, and what isn't pushed yet.

hotspots.title: Problem pills
hotspots.text: Amber and red pills flag problems, like uncommitted changes or a repo with no remote. Click one to filter.

hotspots.title: A project row
hotspots.text: Name, next step, folder, repo state, to-dos, category, status and when it was last worked on. Click a row to open it.

hotspots.title: Side menu
hotspots.text: Jumps straight to any section, with its count. Folded to icons here; pin it open to see the names.

screens.title: A project, opened
screens.caption: Everything about one project: what it is, status, next step, to-dos, log, links, where it lives and time logged.

hotspots.title: Search + toolbar
hotspots.text: Search box, filters and sort for the project list.

hotspots.title: Tracker tools
hotspots.text: Sweep for new folders, add a folder, export or import CSV, and git sync.

hotspots.title: Filter pills

hotspots.title: Project list + detail
hotspots.text: One row per project, grouped by area. Click a row to open its detail panel.

hotspots.title: What it is
hotspots.text: A one-line summary of the project.

hotspots.title: Status and where it stands
hotspots.text: Active, waiting, paused, unreviewed or done, with a short note on where things stand.

hotspots.title: Next step
hotspots.text: The one small action to start with next time.

hotspots.title: Outstanding
hotspots.text: To-dos. Tick one to mark it done (it goes in the log), or edit or remove it.

hotspots.title: Log
hotspots.text: What happened, newest first: notes, status changes, finished to-dos and time logged. Add a line here.

hotspots.title: Links
hotspots.text: Ties the project to Jira projects, Jira codes, goals and catalog items, so filters across the dashboard can find it.

hotspots.title: Where it lives
hotspots.text: The folder, buttons to open it, and the repo's branch, uncommitted changes and last commit.

hotspots.title: Git sync
hotspots.text: Whether the repo is public, private or a fork on GitHub, and when it was last synced.

hotspots.title: Goals
hotspots.text: The goals this project works toward. Link another here.

hotspots.title: Time
hotspots.text: Time logged on this project, and a form to log more, with an optional work code.

hotspots.title: Side menu
hotspots.text: Jumps straight to any section, with its count. Folded to icons here; pin it open to see the names.

screens.title: Today + reports
screens.caption: Today's sessions and the start, mid-day and end-of-day reports.

hotspots.title: Today panel
hotspots.text: Work sessions for a chosen day; day chips pick the day.

hotspots.title: Plan My Day
hotspots.text: Pick today's tasks, carry unfinished ones into a new day, log time against them, and look back at past plans.

hotspots.title: Day reports
hotspots.text: Start-of-day, mid-day and end-of-day snapshots: what was planned, what popped up, what's left. Save as Markdown or PDF to share.

hotspots.title: Day chips
hotspots.text: Pick a day to see the sessions worked that day. The number is how many projects.

hotspots.title: Sessions
hotspots.text: When each project was worked on that day, and how (a session, a note, changed files).

hotspots.title: Add to today's plan
hotspots.text: Pick from to-dos, next steps, the inbox, goals and Jira codes, or type something new.

hotspots.title: A plan item
hotspots.text: Tick it when it's done. Shows its project, where it came from, links, and time logged against it.

hotspots.title: Log time
hotspots.text: Log time against a plan item; the entry remembers which item it was for.

hotspots.title: Open a report
hotspots.text: A start-of-day, mid-day or end-of-day snapshot: what was planned, what popped up and what's left.

hotspots.text: Jumps straight to any section, with its count. Folded to icons here; pin it open to see the names.

hotspots.title: Add a thought
hotspots.text: Drop in anything without deciding where it goes. Sort it later.

hotspots.title: An inbox item
hotspots.text: Sort it to a project to-do or note, a goal, the catalog or a work entry, mark it done, or trash it.

hotspots.title: Sort to
